summary: Phase-2 Manasati (منصتي) testing complete. Focus: Resend email integration, 2 new templates (شركة ناشئة, مطعم وكافيه), and 3 new editor sections (team/pricing/cta). Backend: 35/35 pytest tests PASSED (all 31 original + 4 new: templates count>=6 with both new names, new templates contain team/pricing/cta section types, forgot-password for existing + unknown user, platform contact still persisted in /admin/contacts). Email: every POST to /api/auth/forgot-password and every /api/public/contact + /api/public/site/{sub}/contact triggered a real HTTP POST to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send which returned HTTP 202 Accepted — zero 'Email send error/failed' entries in backend logs. Frontend: fresh customer register → dashboard → create-site modal shows exactly 6 template buttons including 'شركة ناشئة' → selected the new startup template and submitted → editor opened → added team, pricing, cta sections via add-section-team/pricing/cta testids → Save (editor-save) → Publish (editor-publish) → visited /s/{subdomain} and confirmed all three section headings ('فريق العمل', 'باقات الأسعار', 'جاهز للبدء') render on the published page with brand colors applied. Regression flows (register/login, existing sections, admin dashboard) unchanged from iteration_1.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py forgot_password still prints the raw reset token to stdout via `print('[PASSWORD RESET] ... -> token: ...')` even though the email is now delivered by Resend. This leaks a valid password-reset token (1h expiry) to backend logs; anyone with log access could hijack accounts. Remove the print or gate it behind a DEBUG/dev env flag.

email_service.send_email swallows all errors and returns None. That's fine for the caller, but there is no separate metric/counter for send failures — a silent Resend outage would go unnoticed in production. Consider incrementing a counter or emitting a structured log entry with severity ERROR + tag so ops can alert on it.

public.site_contact awaits send_contact_notification synchronously inside the request handler. If Resend is slow (30s httpx timeout), the public visitor waits up to 30s for their form submission. Consider `asyncio.create_task(send_contact_notification(...))` or a background task/queue so the response is instant.

auth.forgot_password: user existence is checked but the endpoint takes noticeably longer when user exists (extra bcrypt-free work + email round-trip) vs when they don't (no work). This creates a timing-attack side channel for user enumeration despite the identical response body. Consider a background task or a fixed-time delay for the miss branch.

Editor.jsx SECTION_TYPES pricing/team plans use free-text `price` string and `features` textarea split by newline — no validation. A user pasting HTML into features will render as text (good, escaped by React) but empty features (blank line) are auto-filtered which silently drops rows. Not a bug, just be aware.

SectionRenderer team/pricing/cta components (not opened here but referenced) should be verified to use brand vars `--brand-primary/--brand-accent` consistently — the published page screenshot confirms accent color and CTA button use brand palette, so appears OK.

Prior iteration_1 comments still stand: /api/auth/me returns 401 on unauth (cosmetic console noise), sites.update_site does not enforce sites plan limit (OK), and there is no CSRF protection beyond SameSite=None cookies.
